headline: President Bush created an advisory council to give the President advice on improving Americans' understanding of money and personal finance.
what_it_does: This executive order set up the President's Advisory Council on Financial Literacy. Based on its title, the council's job was to advise the President on financial literacy, meaning how well people understand things like saving, budgeting, and credit. No summary was provided, so details such as who served on the council and how long it lasted are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Council members appointed by the President
who_it_affects.how: They were given the role of advising the President on financial literacy.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials working on financial education
who_it_affects.how: They may have received advice or recommendations from the council.
